name: Boudewijn Filterapp
description: This project was made for Boudewijn Seapark. It keeps track of what employees do certain tasks, where and when. It was a group project in teams of 3, and it took us about 2 and a half months and more than 20.000 lines of code to complete.

We made a login and register page for the employees where they can create their account and login with a pincode. They can complete general, daily, weekly and monthly tasks, and see a progressbar for each department.

There are daily water analyses to measure for example the temperature and acidity of each pool. If a certain measurement does not meet the quota of the maximum or minimum value, everyone will receive a notification about that measurement.
The admin has the authority to see, create, update and delete tasks, users and measurement definitions. There is also an option to export all the task data to Excel.

name: Laravel Webshop
description: To learn Laravel, I made a complete DVD webshop with a retro look. You can search and filter movies and directors, add items to you shopping cart, and checkout. As an admin you can manage all data in a Filament page.

You can browse DVD's and directors. Filter by name, sort alphabetically or by price. You can see details of the movie like age-rating and duration, and when logged in you can even write reviews to movies.
Shopping cart is saved, so you can continue after reopening the site. Even when not logged in, it's saved in a Cookie. When going to checkout there is a Mollie page that imitates a real payment.

name: Aero Kanban
description: This was my first project while learning React. A basic Kanban Task app with a Strapi server, and possibilities to read, add, edit and delete tasks. All within a React interface styled to resemble Windows 7.

All tasks have a category, which also can be created. You can search in realtime for tasks in the search bar, and filter based on task labels. There also is a backlog with pagination, for access to unused tasks.
For the overall styling, I was inspired by the nostalgic charm and Frutiger Aero aesthetic of Windows 7, using glassy surfaces, radiant hues, and a futuristic feel. Taking a trip down memory lane.

name: First Portfolio
description: I used CraftCMS, a content managing system, for the first time while making this project. So i could update the content without writing any more code. This project is an exercise in making websites as accessible as possible
The website consists of multiple pages like home, about, projects and contact. These are all automatically loaded with the content form CraftCMS.
This was my first project where I made the webpage fully accessible using semantic HTML and correct ARIA-roles. This allows a better user experience for everyone.

name: Binary Library
description: This was my first project using Nextjs. I made an online library for Programming students at Artevelde. Browse books, give ratings and add items to your wishlist.
After you register you get a confirmation mail using Resend, you can search for books, view book details and add a rating. A user can also add books to their wishlist.
The admin can add, edit and delete books. They also can borrow out books to users for 2 weeks. This wil send an email to the user, after 2 weeks the user can extend their book once, or return it.

name: Best of 2024
description: A website to practice my CSS and front-end JavaScript skills. This webpage displays an overview of the best movies, music, and games of the year.
The assignment for this project was to recreate Johan Ronsse’s website as accurately as possible. All the visible data is retrieved from an API.
The website features a fully responsive design, accessible from desktop to smartphone. There is a light/dark mode switcher and a possibility to like songs, these are saved on the local storage.

name: Mealio
description: Mealio is a smart recipe app I developed as my graduation project for the Graduate Program in Programming. Based on the ingredients you already have at home, it shows you what you can cook.
Mealio is an interactive recipe app that suggests suitable recipes using the ingredients you currently have. Missing an ingredient? You can easily add it to your shopping list.
In addition, users can follow specific diets, set their own allergies, and create their own recipes. The app also allows users to rate, like, share, and comment on recipes.

name: Mosaic Builder
description: A small project to turn images into brick mosaics, based on what bricks you have. Upload, choose size, add bricks to your inventory, adjust HSL of image, export to .pdf with preview image and all bricks used.
